description: 256-atom LJ liquid snapshot (rho* = 0.8, T* = 1) and LAMMPS lj/cut single points, 20-step NVE trajectory and RDF; LAMMPS lj units = engine atomic units with epsilon = sigma = m = 1

lammps_inputs.melt: lattice fcc 0.8; region 0 4 (x3); velocity create 3.0 4928459 mom yes rot no dist gaussian; fix nvt temp 1.0 1.0 0.5; timestep 0.005; run 10000; velocity all scale 1.0
lammps_inputs.single_point: run 0; compute pressure NULL virial; thermo_press
lammps_inputs.trajectory: fix nve; timestep 0.005; run 20; dump xu yu zu vx vy vz
lammps_inputs.rdf: compute rdf 68 cutoff 3.4; comm_modify cutoff 3.8; run 0
